note: Every tracked file that carries the release version, classified. A bump edits package.json and then every `pinned` site in ONE pass: these files are mutually referential (tests assert README content, the READMEs document test expectations), so a partial update always fails confusingly. `history` files accumulate versions and are never rewritten. `derived` files are regenerated by npm. Fixed fixture entries count explicit versionParts and optional additionalFixedVersions independently; they do not advance with a product release.
